correctness.rationale: Faces of the Minkowski root-edge zonotope are indexed by ties in edge linear forms. A codimension-two face has n-3 free edges, i.e. three cut edges and three consecutive blocks, and the contracted triangle has six acyclic orientations, yielding n(n-1)(n-2) ridges. Facets are cyclic intervals; for low and high extreme blocks A,C, outward normals -v_A and v_C give positive dot product ac/n and squared cosine ac/((a+b)(b+c)). Every ordered positive composition contributes 2n ridges. Monotonicity in a,c proves the minimum a=c=1 and maximum b=1 with a,c balanced, including even-n double multiplicity. Uniform integer compositions converge to Dirichlet(1,1,1); mapping W=AC/((A+B)(B+C)) with ordered uniforms gives the stated exact logarithmic CDF and bounded expectation pi²/3-3. The inherited metric, not arbitrary affine deformation, is essential.

final_claim: For the unweighted Euclidean cycle graphical zonotope in dimension n-1, n>=4, its complete ridge angle multiset consists of 2n copies per positive ordered a+b+c=n of theta=pi-arccos sqrt(ac/((a+b)(b+c))). With a uniformly selected ridge, W=cos²(theta) converges to CDF 2w(w-1-log w)/(1-w)^2 and mean pi²/3-3; exact extremes and parity-sensitive multiplicities are specified.
limitations: Unweighted canonical Euclidean cycle root-vector zonotope, n>=4; uniform ridge faces, not surface-area or Gaussian direction sampling.
